answer: Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked until dawn of the next epoch, and every action is logged as a signed thread linking it to that stake. To fake identities, an attacker must fund each new key with real copper and maintain a continuous thread of valid signatures through the epoch; creating N sybils costs N times the bond plus the compute to sustain threads, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. The sa0001 deployment anchors trust at iiwSH8Aqvc.
